name: spardutti-mods
description: Claude Code mods: live panels and hooks for daily work

plugins.name: branch-status
plugins.description: A small git-flow graph of main, develop and your branch, with what is waiting to release

plugins.name: auto-handoff
plugins.description: Hands the work to a fresh, named session when the context gets too full, using your /handoff command

plugins.name: handoff-pickup
plugins.description: Reminds you of a handoff you left behind, picks it up with /pickup, and deletes it when you're done

plugins.name: blocked-run
plugins.description: When auto mode blocks a command, shows it above the prompt with a button to run it yourself
